fusions.name: Thrown Tangle
fusions.desc: Hurls a snarl of stinging fronds that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1.2 seconds. It is then [Slowed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Fringe
fusions.desc: Spreads fringed fronds in a cone 3.5 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it, with a 35% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Lured Inshore
fusions.desc: Draws up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A shoal of polyps fights beside you for 9 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hauled In
fusions.desc: When you afflict something, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
